I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread: the ticket for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging is **#88412**.

- **Where it's recorded:** Tobias raised it as a Tier 2 escalation in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025. He described the tablet freezing on the bill of lading (BOL) barcode scan. He first called the account "TP" but then confirmed he meant Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this is something Hollis can see too.
- **Possible mix-up:** I also pointed out ticket #8841 from yesterday in #central-random. That one is the West yard Door 2 double-booking on Tobias's dealer account, so it shouldn't go on the tracker for this issue.

I only read channels Hollis belongs to and didn't use message search. A ticket number is account information rather than a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
